films.title: 25 and Under: An introduction to John Woo
films.description: Are you a member of our 25 and Under scheme? Join us for a free introduction to director John Woo.

films.title: After Hours
films.cast: Griffin Dunne, Rosanna Arquette, Verna Bloom, Catherine O’Hara
films.description: This re-evaluated Scorsese romp sees Griffin Dunne as a chronically bored office worker who is drawn into the most chaotic night of his life.

films.title: UK premiere of 4K restoration: 3 Bad Men
films.cast: George O’Brien, Olive Borden, Tom Santschi, J. Farrell MacDonald, Frank Campeau

films.title: Barbara

films.description: Christian Petzold’s understated, thrilling drama sees a Berlin doctor forced to relocate to a country hospital in 1980s East Germany after a failed exit visa.

films.title: Bhaji on the Beach
films.cast: Kim Vithana, Sarita Khajuria, Shaheen Khan
films.description: Gurinder Chadha’s tale of British Asian women bonding on a coastal day-trip is an understated gem and a vital portrait of Thatcher’s Britain.

films.title: BFI Member Quiz

films.title: A Better Tomorrow
films.cast: Ti Lung, Leslie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat
films.description: This tale of two brothers on the opposite sides of the law marks the emergence of John Woo’s signature action filmmaking style.

films.title: Call Me by Your Name

films.title: Funday: Charlie and Lola – 25th Anniversary
films.description: Celebrate the 25th anniversary of these beloved characters with writer and illustrator Lauren Child.

films.title: Candy Mountain
films.cast: Kevin J O’Connor, Harris Yulin, Tom Waits, Joe Strummer

films.title: Don’t Bother to Knock
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Richard Widmark, Anne Bancroft
films.description: Marilyn Monroe thrills as an unstable babysitter in British director Roy Ward Baker’s psychological thriller.

films.title: Iracema: Uma Transa Amazônica
